description: This Rust source file defines functions and structures for parsing and handling dynamic components within a database row context, including JSON property extraction, recursive stack expansion, and unit tests for JSON processing.

methods.name: parse_dynamic_rows
methods.description: Creates an iterator over DbItems, processing dynamic properties within a row.

methods.name: expand_dynamic_stack
methods.description: Recursively expands a stack of JSON values, extracting nested dynamic components.

methods.name: extract_dynamic_properties
methods.description: Checks if a JSON value has a 'dynamic' component and extracts its properties.

methods.name: dynamic_properties_to_vec
methods.description: Reverses a vector of JSON property results, wrapping each in a Result.

methods.name: dynamic_properties_to_result_vec
methods.description: Converts a JSON value into a vector of JSON values, parsing strings as JSON, handling objects and arrays.
